董事会运作，但必须立即向北京报告。暂停期限可为三个月：在此期间，由总领事直接任命的市政委员会将指导市政事务。当这两种制度应用于同一城镇时，其差异显得尤为显著。
“此岸真理，彼岸谬误”，在小河浜存在之时，人们可以这样说。“直到爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）中线为止是真理，另一边则是谬误”，如今人们会这样说。我们可以想象，市政董事们在某些场合既渴望拥有邻居那样的特权，又渴望摆脱束缚其行动的缰绳。因此，1879年董事会要求扩大其特权，使其与公共租界工部局享有的特权相一致，也就不足为奇了。
1879年3月25日，董事会知悉了委员会提出的修订市政组织章程的方案；批准了所提议的修改；并决定将其提交给法国外交部高级协会，恳请其批准这些已成为必要的修改。

在1879年4月16日的会议上，法国驻北京公使布雷尼埃·德·蒙莫朗子爵（Viscount Brenier de Montmorand）和代办帕特诺特（Patenôtre）先生出席，董事会向领事递交了一份经董事会通过的章程副本，并请其转呈法国外交部长。董事会委派其主席米约先生向外交部长提供所有必要的解释，以获得其对拟议修改的同意。
更有甚者，如果这些解释无效，董事会成员授权主席“以他们的名义将此问题提交众议院，因为他们认为，为了租界的未来和繁荣，对这些章程进行修订至关重要，使其不再束缚以保护租界内私人和商业利益为唯一目标的各项市政服务的正常运作。”
米约先生在其《报告》中写道：“出席会议的布雷尼埃·德·蒙莫朗子爵和帕特诺特先生仅对拟议的修改提出了一些微小的反对意见，但在原则上予以承认。
这些修改未提交给选举人，是因为领事认为让临时领事勒梅尔（Lemaire）先生处于必须召集选举人的微妙境地是不适宜的，正如前任戈多（Godeaux）先生在上述情况（1876年9月事件）下也未遵从社区表达的愿望一样。
董事会在与建议这些修改的布雷尼埃·德·蒙莫朗子爵合作，要求修改1869年市政组织章程时，只是遵循传统。加洛（Gallo）先生和 A. 瓦赞（A. Voisin）先生曾两次受命从事此项工作。
从1879年6月我抵达法国之日起，直到1880年1月，我与领事司司长洛朗（Laurent）先生以及专门负责远东事务的副司长达尔洛伯爵（Count d-Arlot）进行了多次会谈。

V. THE REGULATIONS OF 1868 AND THE PLANS
FOR MODIFICATIONS.

It is time now to reproduce the regulations of 1868
which are still in force at the present time, and the va-
rious modifications proposed. We shall include the Regula-
tions of Hankow, which, formulated in 1908, far from increa-
sing the power and privileges of the Council, augmented on
the contrary those of the Consul. No comment is necessary
on the text which we are about to reproduce: the reader will
make himself familiar with the changes demanded.

Regulation of the Municipal Organization of
the French Concession of April 14, 1868.

ARTICLE 1.
The Municipal Body of the French Concession in Shanghai
consists of the Consul General for France in Shanghai and
eight Municipal Councillors of whom four are French and
four are foreigners, all appointed by means of an election.
The Municipal Councillors are appointed for two years:
they are renewable by half every year.
Councillors who have died or resigned are to be rep -
laced at the same time as those leaving their posts.
However, as soon as the number of Municipal Councillors
is reduced by half a replacement of deceased or resigned
Councillors will take place.

ARTICLE 2.
All French and all foreigners having reached the age of
21 and satisfying the following three conditions, may be-
come electors:-
1. Possessing, by virtue of a right of ownership, land
situated in territory of the Concession.
2. Occupying in the concession the whole or a part of
a house by right of residence and paying an annual rent of
at least a thousand francs.
3. Living in the Concession over three months and ha-
ving an annual income of four thousand francs.

ARTICLE 3.
The Consul General draws up the electoral list, revises
it every year and convenes the meeting of electors.
The election proceedings are verified by the Municipal
Council.

ARTICLE 4.
An ut elector of 25 years of age is eligible.
Retiring municipal councillors can be re-elected.

ARTICLE 5.
The balloting is secret.
Voting takes place by ticket. Every ticket must include
an equal number of French and foreign residents.
The candidates who, amongst French residents have the
most votes are elected to the Municipal Council. The same
applies to candidates of foreign nationalities, who have
obtained the largest number of votes.
One or several Chinese notables or chiefs of corpora-
tions, appointed by the Consul General in agreement with
the Tao-tai, may, if the Council judges it fit, be admitted
to the meetings with a right to consultative vote.

现在是时候重现至今仍有效的1868年章程以及提出的各项修改方案了。我们将包括汉口章程，该章程制定于1908年，非但没有增加董事会的权力和特权，反而增加了领事的权力。对于我们要重印的文本无需评论：读者将自行熟悉所要求的变更。

1868年4月14日法租界市政组织章程。

第一条。
上海法租界市政机构由法国驻上海总领事和八名市政董事组成，其中四名为法国人，四名为外国人，均通过选举产生。
市政董事任期为两年：每年改选一半。
去世或辞职的董事应与离任者同时补选。
然而，一旦市政董事人数减少一半，即应补选去世或辞职的董事。

第二条。
所有年满21岁并满足以下三个条件的法国人和外国人均可成为选民：
1. 凭借所有权拥有位于租界领土内的土地。
2. 凭借居住权在租界内占用全部或部分房屋，并支付至少一千法郎的年租金。
3. 在租界居住超过三个月，并拥有四千法郎的年收入。

第三条。
总领事编制选民名单，每年修订一次，并召集选民会议。

第四条。
年满25岁的选民有被选举资格。
离任市政董事可连选连任。

第五条。
投票采用无记名方式。
投票通过选票进行。每张选票必须包含同等数量的法国居民和外国居民。
在法国居民中获得最多选票的候选人当选为市政董事。同样适用于获得最多选票的外国籍候选人。
经总领事与道台协商任命的一名或多名中国绅董或行会首领，如董事会认为合适，可列席会议并享有咨询投票权。

Regulation of the Municipal Organization of
the French Concession of April 14, 1868.

ARTICLE 9.
The Municipal Council discusses the following matters:-
1) The budget of Municipal income and expenditure.
2) The tariff of the collection of Municipal revenues.
3) The distribution of the taxes amongst the rate-payers
4) The demands for exemption or reduction of taxes.
5) The method of recovering a tax.
6) The acquisition, disposal, exchange and location of
Municipal properties.
7) The opening of roads and public places, a scheme for
the construction of wharves, jetties and canals, the laying
out and the sites of the markets, abattoirs and cemeteries.
8) Health and Sanitation works.
9) Appropriations for public utilities.
10) Health and sanitation laws.
11) All other matters which the Consul-General has asked
the Council to discuss.

ARTICLE 10.
The resolutions of the Municipal Council shall be exe-
cutory only by virtue of the agreement of the Consul-General.
The Consul-General must render executory, within 8 days,
all resolutions relative to one of the matters in Parag-
raphs 1 and 6 of the preceding article.
The Consul-General can, by a decision, with the motive
stated, and under the reserve of the approval of the French
Minister in Peking, which must be sought for without delay,
refuse to render executory a resolution of the Municipal
Council relative to one of the matters mentioned in Parag-
raphs 7 to 11 of the preceding article.
The enforcement of the resolution must remain in abey-
ance until the arrival of the reply from the legation.

ARTICLE 11.
The meetings of the Municipal Council may be open to
the public and the proceedings at the private meetings may
be published by virtue of the special decisions of the Coun-
cil, approved by the Consul-General.
The meetings at which the Council decides upon the an-
nual budget of income and expenditure are always to be open
to the public, at least if a majority of the Council does
not oppose it.

ARTICLE 12.
The Municipal Council is charged with the administra-
tion of public roads, the running and distribution of water,
the lighting of streets, the management and upkeep of Mu-
nicipal properties, the carrying out of works of public
utility, the drawing up of a cadastral plan, the establish-
ment and revision of the lists of taxes and the collection
of Municipal revenues. It is also charged with the task of
suing rate-payers in arrears with their taxes.
The Council appoints its own Secretary.
It also appoints, save with the approval of the Consul-
General, all Municipal employees. It may suspend or revoke
the titles of these employees.

1868年4月14日法租界市政组织章程。

第九条。
市政公董局讨论以下事项：
1) 市政收支预算。
2) 市政税收征收税率。
3) 税款在纳税人之间的分摊。
4) 免税或减税申请。
5) 税款追缴方法。
6) 市政财产的购置、处置、交换及选址。
7) 道路及公共场所的开辟，码头、栈桥及运河的建设方案，市场、屠宰场及墓地的规划与选址。
8) 卫生及清洁工程。
9) 公用事业拨款。
10) 卫生及清洁法规。
11) 总领事要求公董局讨论的所有其他事项。

第十条。
市政公董局的决议仅凭总领事的同意方可执行。
总领事必须在8天内使涉及前条第1款和第6款事项的所有决议生效执行。
总领事可通过一项注明理由的决定，并在保留须经法国驻北京公使批准（须立即寻求批准）的前提下，拒绝使涉及前条第7款至第11款所述事项之一的市政公董局决议生效执行。
在该决议的执行必须暂缓，直至收到公使馆的回复。

第十一条。
市政公董局的会议可向公众开放，闭门会议的议事录可根据公董局经总领事批准的特别决定予以公布。
公董局决定年度收支预算的会议始终应向公众开放，除非公董局多数成员反对。

第十二条。
市政公董局负责公共道路的管理、供水运行及分配、街道照明、市政财产的管理和维护、公用工程的实施、地籍图的绘制、税单的编制和修订以及市政收入的征收。它还负责起诉拖欠税款的纳税人。
公董局任命其自己的秘书。
除需经总领事批准外，公董局还任命所有市政雇员。它可以暂停或撤销这些雇员的职务。

VI. The Disputes of 1880-82.
The new draft of regulations, adopted by the Council of
1879, gave rise to very lengthy controversies. It appeared
in any case to be very far from the spirit of the new Council
of 1880, as had been telegraphed, very justly by the Consul
General at Shanghai, to the Quai d'Orsay, for, during the
years 1880-1881, no mention is made of the plan which had
been adopted by the preceding Council. The present Council
was asleep on its position when it was awakened by the arri-
val in Shanghai of a brochure entitled, "France in the Far
East-the French Concession in Shanghai. Lecture before the
Indo-China Academic Society by Mr. Ernest Millot".
At the end of this brochure the following note was found;
"This lecture was printed when I had undertaken the task of
prevailing over the Department of Foreign Affairs to the ideas
which I have briefly developed before the Indo-China Academic
Society on the regulations of the French Municipal Council
in Shanghai. I had besides been delegated to France to this
effect in 1879 by the Municipal Council and I had at this pe-
riod opened the pourparlers which proved abortive: that is all
I can say for the moment. But to-day I have the pleasure to
announce that satisfaction has just been finally given to the
desire so long expressed by the French residents in our Con-
cession. The regulations will be altered. This result is due
to Mr. Ballue, Deputy of the Rhone, who had taken to heart
the prosperity and interests of the French citizens in this
part of the Far East, and to Mr. de Freycinet whose alert spi-
rit of patriotism admirably seized the question at the special
interview which he gave us on March 5 at the request of Mr.
Ballue.
In future, French Councillors appointed by French elec-
tors must reside in the French Concession: the foreign Coun-
cillors must be elected by foreign electors. The President
of the Council will be French and will be appointed by the
Consul-General, who, being President by right, can delegate
him his powers.
As to the staff of the Municipality, composed of French
and Chinese elements, they will be justifiable to the French
Consular tribunal. Such were the essential provisions of the
new regulations destined to give a new impulse to the impor-
tant Concession which France possessed in North China.
The French residents in Shanghai will be sensible to Mr.
de Freycinet for this patriotic determination, and to Mr.
Ballue for having promoted it.
The Council was more than strongly moved. The Council, it
was said at the meeting of July 24, 1882, (in the greatest
heat of Shanghai) expressed great surprise and manifested
lively indignation upon seeing Mr. Millot being thus permit-
ted to speak in the name of the French electors in Shanghai
which he was not in the least qualified to represent, for he
had left town for more than three years and had ceased to be
a part of the Council for a year and a half, although he had
kept the mandate of Councillor during the 21 months of his
stay in France.
If he had a Mandate it was to bring about the adoption of
the regulations adopted by the Council in 1879. Then after
an address, the President remarked to his colleagues that the
regulations which Mr. Millot said had been accepted by the
Department for Foreign Affairs and those which he had been
charged to secure approval thereof are diametrically opposite.

六、1880-82年的争端。
1879年董事会通过的新章程草案引发了非常漫长的争议。无论如何，它似乎与1880年新董事会的精神相去甚远，正如上海总领事非常公正地向法国外交部（Quai d'Orsay）电报所指出的那样，因为在1880-1881年间，人们只字未提前任董事会通过的方案。当一本题为《远东的法国——上海法租界。埃内斯特·米洛先生在印度支那学术学会的演讲》的小册子抵达上海时，现任董事会才从沉睡中惊醒。
在这本小册子的末尾，发现了如下注释：“当我着手促使外交部接受我在印度支那学术学会简要阐述的关于上海法国市政董事会章程的观点时，本次演讲付印。此外，我于1879年受市政董事会委派为此事前往法国，并在那一时期开启了最终无果而终的谈判：这是我目前所能说的一切。但今天，我很高兴地宣布，长期以来表达的我们租界法国居民的愿望终于得到了满足。章程将被修改。这一成果归功于罗讷省议员巴吕先生（Mr. Ballue），他将远东这一地区法国公民的繁荣和利益放在心上；也归功于弗雷西内先生（Mr. de Freycinet），他在应巴吕先生要求于3月5日给予我们的特别接见中，以其敏锐的爱国精神极好地把握了这一问题。
今后，由法国选民选出的法国董事必须居住在法租界内；外籍董事必须由外国选民选出。董事会主席将为法国人，并由总领事任命，总领事作为法定主席，可将权力委托给他。
至于由法国人和中国人组成的市政职员队伍，他们将受法国领事法庭管辖。这就是旨在为法国在华北拥有的重要租界注入新活力的新章程的基本条款。
上海的法国居民将对弗雷西内先生的这一爱国决定表示感谢，并对巴吕先生的推动表示感谢。
董事会受到了极大的震动。据说，在1882年7月24日的会议上（正值上海最炎热之际），董事会表示极大惊讶，并对米洛先生被允许以上海法国选民的名义发言表现出强烈的愤慨，因为他根本没有资格代表他们，因为他已离开上海三年多，并已停止担任董事会成员一年半，尽管他在法国停留的21个月期间仍保留着董事的委任状。
如果他负有委任状，其目的是促成通过董事会在1879年通过的章程。随后，在一番致辞后，主席向同事们指出，米洛先生称已被外交部接受的章程，与他受命争取批准的章程截然相反。

The Principal clauses of the plan of the Council of
1879 were:
1. To elect the President of the Council directly by the
members of the Council.
2. To place the Municipal Police directly under the or-
ders of the Council.
Now according to what Mr. Millot has declared, the Consul-
General retains the right to be President of the Council and
the Police are placed directly under his orders.
Consequently it is absolutely useless to change the re-
gulations of 1868, in this sense: that it would be acting
against the liberal spirit of the first regulations.
Mr. Lillot had much less right to present himself to ob-
tain a new regulation for on August 7, 1880, the Council had
telegraphed to him: "Cease all proceedings on behalf of the
Council". (Note: The reason of this telegram being sent was
not to prevent Mr. Lillot from taking steps in regard to the
plan of regulations: it referred, as Mr. Lillot explained,
to the engagement of an engineer for the Municipality.)
After mature considerations the Council demanded of its
President to call upon the Consul to ask him whether it was
true that the Department of Foreign Affairs had adopted the
present regulations in the sense indicated by Mr. Lillot's
brochure.
In case of the answer being in the affirmative, he was to
be asked to be good enough to take note that Mr. Lillot had no
mandate from Shanghai; that the Municipal Council alone had
the power to draw up a scheme, and that this scheme is first
to be submitted for consideration before the rate-payers in
general meeting under the Presidency of the Consul. "This
mode of revision", the Council added, "conforms to the pre-
sent institution of Communal franchises and to the new laws
which regulate so happily the French Municipalities".
The Consul, when questioned, manifested great surprise
upon seeing "that the Council had been informed by a brochure
of Mr. Lillot that the Department of Foreign Affairs had, at
the entreaty of the said Mr. Lillot, contemplated the revision
of the present Regulations. He had actually received from the
Minister a plan on this subject, but this plan did not have
the definite character which Mr. Lillot's brochure gave it".
The President, Mr. Vouillemont, then asked the Consul to
be good enough to communicate to the Council the plan. The
Consul took refuge behind the instructions received which pro-
hibited from giving official Communications on the plan in
question to the Council, but informed him that "he would com-
municate officially to each member of the Council who would

1879年工部局计划的主要条款为：
1. 由工部局成员直接选举工部局主席。
2. 将巡捕房直接置于工部局的指挥之下。
然而，根据米洛先生（Mr. Millot）的声明，总领事保留担任工部局主席的权利，且巡捕房直接受其指挥。
因此，在此意义上修改1868年的章程是绝对无用的，因为这将违背最初章程的自由精神。
利洛先生（Mr. Lillot）更无权出面争取新章程，因为工部局曾于1880年8月7日向他发电报称：“停止代表工部局采取的一切行动”。（注：发送此电报的原因并非阻止利洛先生就章程计划采取行动；正如利洛先生所解释的那样，这指的是为公董局聘请一名工程师一事。）
经过深思熟虑，工部局要求其主席去拜访总领事，询问法国外交部是否确实按照利洛先生小册子中所指出的含义通过了现行章程。
如果答复是肯定的，则应请他注意，利洛先生并未获得上海的授权；只有工部局有权起草方案，且该方案首先须在总领事主持下的纳税人大会上提交审议。工部局补充道：“这种修订方式符合当前的社区特权制度，也符合 happily 规范法国市政当局的新法律。”
总领事在被问及此事时，表现出极大的惊讶，因为他看到“工部局是通过利洛先生的一本小册子得知，法国外交部应利洛先生的恳求，考虑修订现行章程。他实际上已从部长那里收到了一份关于此主题的计划，但该计划并不具备利洛先生小册子所赋予它的那种确定性特征”。
随后，主席武耶蒙先生（Mr. Vouillemont）请总领事将该计划告知工部局。总领事以收到的指示为由进行推脱，这些指示禁止他就有关计划向工部局发出正式公文，但他通知主席说，“他将正式向每一位前来总领事馆查阅该计划的工部局成员提供”。
武耶蒙先生退席时，提出了他奉命以工部局名义提出的保留意见。

The Committee met for the first time on August 7, it desired above all to devote itself to an inquiry into the opinion of those interested.
The draft of the regulations seen at the Consulate not having been officially communicated and the General meeting not being convenable except by the Consul-General, the Committee preferred to form an opinion by consulting those interested in separate groups.
The first group which appeared to it useful to consult was that of independent electors, that is to say, those who had the right to vote and are eligible, not because of their land holdings, but because they have their business or their domicile in the Concession.
The Consul regarded them, whether rightly or wrongly, as independent, because they had nothing to do with the Council - one could have accused the members of the Commission of having called in the Employees to increase the number of votes in their favour - and because they had no connection either with the Consulate or with the Missions.
There were but 17 of such independent electors, for this reason; says the report of the meeting, "that the interests of the land owners causing them above all to construct warehouses and shops, European dwelling houses are very rare, the French Concession being above all a business place".
The list of independents was certified to be correct by the Consulate.
Of these 17 electors eleven went to the meeting, it will be very interesting to give their names: Messrs Berthet, Bon, Campana, Guion, Girard, Liaigre, Forcebois, Porte, Possel, Resplandi, Saint Bois; Messrs Seisson and Videau, proprietors of the Hotel des Colonies, excused themselves by writing to the Committee that they had never occupied themselves with municipal questions and that they desired to hold themselves away from all discussion on this subject. There remained one more independent, Mr. Teillol, representative of Mr. Millot; he was evidently not summoned, his vote being found to be connected with the situation.
Mr. Vouillement unfolded before the meeting the events which had taken place, read the irritating passage from the pamphlet of Mr. Millot, named the mandate for whom he appeared etc., and set forth the following reasons:
"The first and most important modification, that which concerns us, French electors, most particularly, is that which orders that in future French Councillors will be appointed by French electors and foreign Councillors by foreign electors.
"Without pausing to deal with the anomaly of these powers being drawn from two different sources, which could not fail to bring about a state of acute antagonism between the two classes of Councillors which would be created, we will content ourselves by remarking that he who suggests such a proposition has given little consideration to what he was asking. We will not explain ourselves on this question, we will content ourselves by placing before your eyes the spectacle of the division of all French citizens who had the right to vote and were eligible in the French Concession according to present regulations".

委员会于8月7日首次召开会议，它希望首要致力于调查相关利益方的意见。
由于在总领事馆看到的章程草案并未正式传达，且只有总领事才能召集大会，委员会倾向于通过分别咨询各利益群体来形成意见。
它认为有必要咨询的第一个群体是独立选民，即那些拥有投票权和被选举权的人，并非因为其土地持有量，而是因为他们在租界内有业务或住所。
无论正确与否，总领事将他们视为独立人士，因为他们与工部局无关——人们本可以指责委员会成员召集雇员以增加有利于他们的票数——并且他们既与总领事馆无关，也与传教团无关。
此类独立选民仅有17人，会议报告称，原因是“土地所有者的利益主要促使他们建造仓库和商店，欧式住宅非常罕见，因为法租界主要是一个商业场所”。
独立选民名单经总领事馆认证为准确无误。
在这17名选民中，有11人出席了会议，列出他们的名字将非常有趣：贝尔泰先生（Berthet）、邦先生（Bon）、坎帕纳先生（Campana）、吉永先生（Guion）、吉拉尔先生（Girard）、利亚格尔先生（Liaigre）、福尔斯布瓦先生（Forcebois）、波特先生（Porte）、波塞尔先生（Possel）、雷斯普兰迪先生（Resplandi）、圣布瓦先生（Saint Bois）；殖民地酒店（Hotel des Colonies）的所有者塞松先生（Seisson）和维多先生（Videau）致信委员会表示歉意，称他们从未关注过市政问题，并希望远离对此主题的任何讨论。还剩下一名独立选民，即米洛先生（Mr. Millot）的代表泰约尔先生（Mr. Teillol）；显然没有传唤他，因为发现他的投票与局势有关联。
武耶蒙先生（Mr. Vouillement）向会议阐述了已发生的事件，宣读了米洛先生小册子中令人恼火的段落，说明了他所代表的授权等，并陈述了以下理由：
“第一个也是最重要的修改，即特别关乎我们法国选民的修改，是规定今后法国董事由法国选民选举，外国董事由外国选民选举。
“我们暂且不谈这种权力源自两个不同来源的反常现象，这不可避免地会在两类新产生的董事之间引发尖锐的对立状态，我们仅指出，提出此类建议的人对其要求缺乏深思熟虑。我们将不对此问题进行解释，仅向各位展示根据现行章程，在法租界拥有投票权和被选举权的所有法国公民分裂的景象”。
这一图景将显示，在法租界拥有房产的法国土地所有者或法国社团，但未居住在那里或其办公地点不在那里的，拥有12票；总领事及领事馆职员拥有6票；邮局拥有2票；传教团拥有25票；公董局雇员拥有19票；独立选民拥有17票。

当主席询问是否有人发表意见时，一名选民起身表示，在过去21年里，他从未听到有人抱怨现行体制 (a) 。随后主席提出以下问题进行表决：

所有人都给予了否定回答，并在一份反对米洛先生（Mr. illot）小册子的抗议书上签了名。
报告带着明显的满意之情补充道：“所有在场成员都急忙这样做了”。

They too protested against this article which deprived those

right, enjoyed by them until then, of having a deliberate

vis the foreigners and it led to nothing else but to deprive

reason is neither clear nor very exact; but they upheld the
Committee's point of view and this sufficed to the latter
for the time being.
It had, therefore, to request them to write accordingly
to the Consul General for France, and this was done. It is
rather remarkable to find in this letter a point which was
also raised at the last elections: that of the right of all
Frenchmen residing in Shanghai and not only exclusively in
the Concessions, to have the right to vote. Some of their
reasons are no more valid with the development of the Con-
cession, whilst others have retained their strength.
"We regret to learn" they wrote to the Consul General,
"that the new scheme contains no provision whatever granting
us a consultative vote in the affairs of the Concession, as
we thought we could expect from any revision adopted by the
French Government.
Though residing in the Foreign Settlement, we have the
interests of our country none the less at heart. Permit us
to assure you that it is not because we are living in the
North of the Canal which separates the two Concessions that
we would not be interested in the prosperity of French Con-
cession.
You know personally that if we do not reside in larger
numbers in our Concession, it is because it is entirely
given over to native trade owing to its being near to the
Chinese city; that European houses are very scarce and that
the small number that remains seems to be diminishing more
and more to give place to godowns and houses inhabited by
natives".
The reply to this question thus raised is perhaps the
strongest point of argument which is to be found in the rep-
ly made to Mr. Fillot. We transcribe it herewith:- "The
interest borne by our establishment cannot", says he "con-
stitute a right to meddle in its administration, neither by
right of consultation. It is necessary in addition to ha -
ving a share in the general charges, either directly by
being inscribed on the roll of rate-payers, or indirectly
by residing as employee or sub-tenant of houses whose land-
lords or principal tenants pay taxes, established proportion-
ally, either by the rent value of the number of inhabitants.
That was the sense of paragraphs 1 and 2 of article 3 of
the scheme which was sent in 1873 to the Minister for Fo-
reign Affairs signed by Messrs Bluntschli and Lester the
present councillors, and Viney sub-agent of the Comptoir
d'Escompte.
It referred to the establishment of a Mixed Commission
composed half of French and half of foreigners, that is,
a committee to take charge of administering the material
interests of the Community and not to elect a Municipal
Council, and which could, as in France for instance, apart
from electing senators, act as a political body.
The desire expressed by signatory makers seems to me
in the present state of affairs of a purely sentimental nature".

他们也抗议这一条款，因为它剥夺了那些在我们租界拥有土地的法国人此前一直享有的、在租界事务中拥有 deliberative vote（审议投票权/决定性投票权）的权利。“他使他们”，他们写道，“处于一种相对于外国人而言有损其爱国心的劣势地位，而这除了剥夺他们在法租界购置财产的愿望外，别无其他结果，因为在法租界的行政管理中，他们作为法国人的资格被剥夺了所有参与权”。后一个理由既不清楚也不十分确切；但他们坚持委员会的观点，这对委员会来说暂时已经足够了。

尽管居住在外侨居留地，我们依然心系国家利益。请允许我们向您保证，并非因为我们居住在分隔两个租界的运河以北，我们就不会对法租界的繁荣感兴趣。
您 personally（亲自）知道，如果我们中没有更多人居住在我們的租界，那是因为它靠近中国城市，完全致力于华人贸易；欧式房屋非常稀少，且现存的少量房屋似乎正日益减少，以便为仓库和华人居住的房屋让出空间”。
对这一由此提出的问题之答复，或许是在给菲洛先生（Mr. Fillot）的回复中能找到的最有力的论点。我们在此转录如下：“我们机构所承载的利益”，他说，“不能构成干涉其行政管理的权利，无论是通过咨询权还是其他权利。此外，还必须分担公共费用，要么直接通过登记在纳税人名册上，要么间接通过作为房东或主要租户按比例缴纳房产税的房屋的雇员或转租户居住，该税额是根据租金价值或居民人数确定的。这就是1873年发送给外交部长的方案中第三条第1款和第2款的含义，该方案由现任董事布隆奇利先生（Messrs Bluntschli）和莱斯特先生（Lester）以及贴现银行副代理维尼先生（Viney）签署。
它指的是建立一个混合委员会，由一半法国人和一半外国人组成，也就是说，建立一个负责管理共同体物质利益的委员会，而不是选举一个市政委员会，并且该委员会可以像例如在法国那样，除了选举参议员外，作为一个政治机构行事。
在我看来，签名者所表达的愿望在目前的事态下纯属情感性质”。

45.

Mr. Millot's pamphlet was examined at a meeting of the
Council on August 16, 1882, which was a special meeting, at
which everything was subject to criticism; the rather lively
observations which had been made were approved of unani-
mously by the whole Council; the report of the Committee
as well as extracts of the Council deliberations concerning
this matter were printed; twelve copies were sent to the
French Consulate general and the Council requested the Con-
sul to have them sent to Peking and Paris.
Tired by this struggle, carried on during the greatest
summer heat, the Council probably slept a little or sojourned in
the country.
The return of Autumn and the Winter cold gave new strength
to the Councillors and it can be believed that quite a live-
ly campaign was conducted prior to the elections of January
1883.
It was just at this period on January 20, 1883 that Mr.
Millot's reply reached the Council. It was, as we have sta-
ted, a kind of pamphlet wherein the author justifies him-
self and accuses his contradictors; it is not the purpose
of this sketch to analyze it.
The Council treated it rather lightly; the campaign
which it had been leading resulted in quite a definite vic-
tory at the last elections, because it could not yet get
over the abuse of the power committed by a former Chairman
of the Council who permitted himself to discuss, by his own
authority, at the Department of Foreign Affairs, schemes
of regulations which the Council felt alone qualified to
determine. It was, therefore, on this special point that the
elections of 1883 bore.
"As you know Gentlemen", cried out triumphantly Mr.
Vouillaumout" out of respect for a desire expressed by the
Consul General for France in notice convoking the electors,
French residents, who were in Shanghai on January 11 deemed
it an honour to deposit their voting ticket personally.
During the last elections 51 electors out of 60 came to the
balloting, 3 only voted by procuration and six were absent.
Out of these 51 electors two had signed the protest of
August 18 against Mr. Millot's actions.
136 tickets were deposited in the ballot-box, 67 of
which were French and 67 foreign; out of those 136 there was
one blank ticket; 135 votes had therefore been expressed
and I had the honour of seeing myself re-elected unanimously!
The Council stated once more that it did not see any
usefulness to reply to Mr. Millot's allegations and that the
question was settled.

It was so to such an extent that we looked in vain fur-
theron for any allusion to some modifications to be proposed
in the Regulations of 1883 and if our memory serves us right,
it is necessary to turn to 1906 or 1907 to see some changes
brought into the qualifications of the electors; they were
again introduced not by the Council, but by Mr. Rafard, the
Consul-General, under circumstances which are still fresh in
the memory of the middle aged residents.
Shall we remain for ever subject to the same regulations?
Will there be no definite modifications made to the more li-
beral regulations of 1787? Will the right of vote ever be
extended to more people? The last elections have in any case
proved that this question, even to Frenchmen, did not rep-
resent a case of exceptional urgency: it may even be said
that a very small number of people voted for Dr. Vallet's
programme. The inquiries made by us show that the votes in
his name were made through personal sympathy for him or
because it was desired to eliminate another opponent. His
programme such as it was brought forward was too radical and

米约先生（Mr. Millot）的小册子在1882年8月16日的工部局会议上进行了审议，那是一次特别会议，会上所有事项均受到批评；所提出的相当激烈的意见得到了整个工部局的一致认可；委员会的报告以及工部局关于此事的议事记录摘录均已印刷；十二份副本被送往法国总领事馆，工部局请求总领事将其转送北京和巴黎。
在这场发生于盛夏酷暑期间的斗争中感到疲惫的工部局成员们，大概稍事休息或去乡下小住了。
秋季的回归和冬季的寒冷给了董事们新的力量，可以相信，在1883年1月的选举之前开展了一场相当激烈的竞选活动。
正是在这个时期，1883年1月20日，米约先生的回复送达工部局。如前所述，这是一本小册子，作者在书中为自己辩护并指责他的反对者；分析此书并非本简述的目的。
工部局对此处理得较为轻描淡写；其所领导的竞选活动在最近的选举中取得了相当明确的胜利，因为工部局尚未能摆脱前任主席滥用权力的行为所带来的影响，该主席曾擅自允许自己在外交部讨论规章方案，而工部局认为只有自己才有资格决定这些方案。因此，1883年的选举正是围绕这一特殊点展开的。
“诸位先生，正如你们所知”，武亚蒙先生（Mr. Vouillaumout） triumphantly（得意地）喊道，“出于对法国总领事在召集选民通知中所表达愿望的尊重，1月11日在上海的法国居民认为亲自投递选票是一种荣誉。在上次选举中，60名选民中有51人前来投票，仅3人委托投票，6人缺席。在这51名选民中，有两人签署了8月18日反对米约先生行为的抗议书。
投票箱中共投入136张选票，其中67张为法国人选票，67张为外侨选票；在这136张选票中，有一张空白票；因此共有135票有效表达，我有幸看到自己以全票再次当选！”
工部局再次声明，认为回复米约先生的指控并无必要，且该问题已得到解决。

事实确实如此，以至于我们此后再也找不到任何关于提议修改1883年章程的痕迹，如果我们的记忆没错的话，必须追溯到1906年或1907年才能看到选民资格发生了一些变化；这些变化再次引入并非由工部局发起，而是由总领事拉法尔先生（Mr. Rafard）在中年居民仍记忆犹新的情况下进行的。
我们将永远受制于同样的规章吗？1787年更为自由的规章会不会有明确的修改？投票权是否会扩展到更多人？无论如何，最近的选举证明，这个问题，即使对法国人而言，也不代表一种特殊的紧迫情况：甚至可以说，只有极少数人为瓦莱医生（Dr. Vallet）的纲领投票。我们进行的调查显示，投给他名字的票是出于对他个人的同情，或者是为了排除另一位对手。他所提出的纲领过于激进，并且

46.

did not sufficiently take into consideration the land in
which we live and the foreign company which surrounds us.
The electors were frankly hostile to him and the Consul Ge-
neral plainly emphasized it. Upon opening the meeting of
January 22 he said to the Council which was just nominated
(see the account of the installation meeting).
"Gentlemen, I have great pleasure to see you here. The
election of new members of the Council has been a great suc-
cess; the number of votes gathered by each of them indicates
sufficiently the determination of public opinion. It seems in-
dispensable to me to state here that the great modifica-
tions of the statute of our Concession, which were mentioned
in the programme of one of your opponents, would in no case
whatever, have been approved of by the French Government".

More than opportunism could be detected in these words;
there is a programme mentioned! Time sanctions more and more
the old imperial regulations it will therefore be more dif-
ficult to have modifications adopted. The question of changes
cannot be dealt with otherwise than by a crisis between the
Consul and the Council and will have to be preceded by a
strong campaign.
However, in all these questions of common administra-
tion it is the union between the two powers that matters the
most; it is that which gives the best practical interpre-
tation to the regulations and it is that which we sincerely
wish for the greatest prosperity of our Concession.

没有充分考虑到我们所生活的土地以及包围我们的外国公司。
选民们对他坦率地表示敌意，总领事也明确强调了这一点。在1月22日会议开幕时，他对刚刚当选的工部局说道（参见就职会议记录）。
“诸位先生，很高兴在这里见到你们。新工部局成员的选举取得了巨大成功；每个人获得的票数充分表明了公众舆论的决心。我认为在此必须指出，你们的某位对手纲领中提到的对我们租界章程的重大修改，在任何情况下都不会得到法国政府的批准”。

在这些话语中可以察觉到的不仅仅是 opportunism（机会主义/权宜之计）；这里提到了一个纲领！时间越来越认可旧的帝国规章，因此要使修改获得通过将更加困难。变更问题只能通过总领事与工部局之间的危机来处理，并且在此之前必须进行一场强有力的竞选活动。
然而，在所有这些共同管理的问题中，最重要的是两股权力之间的联合；这是对规章最好的实际诠释，也是我们真诚希望为我们租界带来最大繁荣的因素。
